slides.headline: 6 AI PROMPTS THAT CLOSE ANY COMPLAINT IN 2 MINUTES. MOST BUSINESSES TAKE DAYS.
1) HANDLE ANY COMPLAINT IN 2 MINUTES
slides.body: Klarna's AI handled 2.3 million customer conversations in one month, doing the work of 700 full-time agents, with an average resolution time under 2 minutes (Klarna, 2024). Every tool you need to do the same is free today. PROMPT: "You are a customer service expert. A customer wrote: [paste complaint]. Write a reply under 100 words: acknowledge the issue, apologize sincerely, offer one clear solution, and close warmly."

slides.headline: 2) TURN A 1-STAR REVIEW INTO A 5-STAR IMPRESSION
slides.body: A business that ignores a bad review loses the person who complained and every person who reads the unanswered reply. A 60-second AI reply changes both outcomes. PROMPT: "A customer left this review: [paste review]. Write a public reply under 80 words: thank them for the feedback, apologize for the experience, name one specific corrective action, and invite them to return."

slides.headline: 3) BUILD YOUR ENTIRE FAQ IN ONE CONVERSATION
slides.body: Most small businesses field the same 8 to 10 questions every single week. One 20-minute AI session writes answers that clear the inbox forever. PROMPT: "I run a [describe your business]. My customers ask these questions every week: [list your 8, 10 most common questions]. Write a clear, friendly answer to each in under 50 words. Format: question, then answer."

slides.headline: 4) WRITE THE EMAIL THAT BRINGS CUSTOMERS BACK
slides.body: The businesses with the highest repeat purchase rates all do one thing: send a personal note three days after the first sale. AI writes it in 30 seconds. PROMPT: "Write a follow-up email from [your business name], sent three days after a customer's first purchase of [product]. Address them by first name, ask how they are enjoying it, and include one warm reason to come back. Under 120 words."

slides.headline: 5) HANDLE A REFUND REQUEST WITHOUT LOSING THE CUSTOMER
slides.body: The wrong refund response costs you twice: the refund and the repeat business. Customers whose complaint is resolved within 24 hours are 70% more likely to repurchase than those who wait longer (Zendesk CX Trends, 2023). PROMPT: "A customer requested a refund and wrote: [paste message]. Reply in under 100 words. Acknowledge their frustration, confirm the refund within 3, 5 days, and offer one goodwill gesture that makes them feel valued."

slides.headline: 6) SEND THE REPLY THAT BUYS YOU 24 HOURS
slides.body: The fastest businesses acknowledge faster. A customer who gets a real response in under a minute will wait a full day for the complete answer without leaving a bad review. PROMPT: "A customer just messaged about [issue]. Write an instant reply under 60 words: confirm you received their message, set a 24-hour window for a full answer, and make them feel heard. Professional and warm."

slides.headline: SAVE THIS
slides.body: You will want all 6 prompts the next time a complaint lands in your inbox. Save this post and you will always have them. Daily AI news and real skills: follow for more

caption:
Swipe through these 6 prompts and your customer service practically runs itself. 🤖

Handle any complaint in 2 minutes, turn a 1-star review into a public win, build your entire FAQ in one session, write the email that gets repeat buyers, handle a refund request without losing the customer, send the instant reply that buys you 24 hours.

Customer service is the job most business owners dread. One ignored complaint in public costs more than the refund ever would. These six prompts cover every situation you will face, each in under a minute.
